# Ocean.io

Ocean.io provides GTM intelligence for searching, enriching, and identifying companies and people that match an ideal customer profile.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ocean-io/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete Values** (read-only): Return Ocean.io suggestions for a company, keyword, job title, location, or skill query.
- **Enrich Company**: Match and enrich one company from a domain, name, or LinkedIn URL, optionally using people as matching context.
- **Enrich Person**: Match and enrich one professional profile using person identifiers and optional company context.
- **Gather Missing Company Data**: Check 1-500 company domains and return every Ocean.io outcome category.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return general and specialized Ocean.io credit balances plus the remaining daily request allowance and reset time.
- **Get Data Field Values** (read-only): Return one Ocean.io taxonomy used to construct search filters, with optional case-insensitive local filtering and a bounded result set.
- **Lookup Companies** (read-only): Lookup and enrich 1-1000 companies by domain.
- **Lookup People** (read-only): Lookup up to 1000 professional profiles by LinkedIn handle, Ocean.io person ID, or both.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Search and page through companies using at least one non-empty company or employee filter.
- **Search People** (read-only): Search one page of professional profiles with typed person and employer filters.
